chapter.verse: Tua nung ciangin Zeisu Galile gam sungah a vak hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Judah mite in Topa thah dingin zong uh ahih ciangin, Judah gam sungah vak ding a ut kei hi.
Tua lai takin Judah mite’ Buk pawikham ding a nai zo hi.
Zeisu’ sanggamte in, “Na bawl nate na nungzuite in a muh nadingun, hih pan paikhia in la, Judah gamah na pai in.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, mite kiangah a kithei nuampa in a kilang lona sungah bangmah a hih kei hi. Hih nate na bawl leh, leitungah na pumpi na kilangsak in,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
Bang hangin tua bangin a ci uh hiam i cih leh, a sanggamte in zong Zeisu a um kei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Zeisu in, “Ka hun a tung nai kei hi; note hun ahih leh, a kicingkhol niloh hi.
Leitung mite in no hong mudah thei kei uh hi. Kei hong mudah uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amau’ gamtatna a hoih kei ci-in teci ka pang hi.
Tua pawikhawmna ah no na pai un. Kei hih pawikhamna sungah ka pai nai kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua thu a gen khit ciangin, Galile gamah a om lai hi.
A sanggamte pawikhamna-ah a paikhit uh ciangin, Zeisu zong a kilang loin a paisim hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah mite in, “Koi lai-ah a om hiam?” ci-in dong uh a, pawi sungah a zong uh hi.
Mihonpite in ama hangin thu tampi kikum uh hi. Mi kimkhat in, “Amah mipha ahi hi,” ci uh a, mi kimkhat in, “Mipha ahi kei hi, mihonpite a kheempa ahi hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Judah mite a kihtak manunah kuamah in a tel takin a gen ngam kei uh hi.
Pawikhamna a kimkhat a bawl lai takun, Zeisu biakna innpi-ah paito-a thu a hilh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah mite in, “Hih mi in laisim ngei lo napi-in bangci lai a thei hiam?” ci-in lamdang a sa uh hi.
Tua ciangin Zeisu in, “Ka thuhilhna in keima thu ahi kei hi; kei hong sawlpa’ thu ahi hi.
Mi khatpeuh mah in Pasian’ deih bangin a gamtat nop leh, hih thu Pasian’ thu ahi hiam, keima utthu banga gen ka hi hiam a thei ding hi.
Ama utthu bang a hihpa in ama minthan’na a zong hi. A hong sawlpa minthan’na a zong mi ahih leh, thuman thutak mi hi a, ama sungah diklohna a om kei hi.
Moses in Thukhamna no hong pia hilo ahi hiam? Ahih hangin note khat beek in hih Thukhamna na tang kei uh hi. Kei thah dingin bang hangin na hong zong uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Mihonpite in, “Nang dawilawm nei na hi hi. Nang thah dingin kua in hong zong ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Sabbath ni-a ka bawlna thu khat note khempeuh in lamdang na sa uh hi.
Moses in vunatna thu no hong pia hi. Ahih hangin Moses kiang pan na ngah uh ka ci kei hi; tanglai i pu i pate kiang pan na ngah uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin, Sabbath ni-in vun na at uh hi.
Moses’ Thukhamna a siat thei loh nadingin Sabbath ni-in mi in vunatna a ngah hi. Ahih hangin Sabbath ni-in mi’ pumpi khat ka damsak ciangin bang hangin kei tungah heh na hi uh hiam?
Maitang zahtakna tawh thu na khen kei un; aman takin thu na khen un,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Jerusalem khuami kimkhat in, “Hih pa in thah dinga a zon’pa uh hilo ahi hiam?
En un, amah in a kilangin thu a hilh hangin kuamah in a kham kei hi. Hih pa in Khazih hi cih upa vaihawmte in a thei takpi uh hiam?
Ahih hangin hihpa koipan hong pai cih i thei hi. Khazih hong pai ciangin ama pian’na kuamah in a thei kei ding hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Zeisu in, “Note in kei nong thei uh hi. Ka pian’na lah nong thei uh hi. Ahih hangin keima ut bangin hong pai ka hi kei hi. Kei hong sawlpa in thuman thutak tawh a dim hi. Tua pa na thei kei uh hi.
Keimah in ka thei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama kiang panin kong pai a, amah in kei hong sawl hi,” ci-in biakna innpi sungah a hilh lai takin a kiko hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Topa mat nadingin a vaihawm uh hangin ama hun tung nai lo ahih ciangin, kuamah in ama tungah khut a nga kei hi.
Mihonpi lakah mi tampite in amah um uh a, “Khazih hong pai ciangin hih pa’ lah sangin nalamdang zaw a lak ding hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Mihonpite kikupna thu a theih uh ciangin, siampite leh Farisaite in Topa man dingin palikte a sawl uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Zeisu in, “Note tawh tawlkhat bek ka om khit ciangin kei hong sawlpa kiangah ka ciahkik ding hi.
Nong zon’ uh hangin nong mu kei ding uh hi. Ka omna mun nong tung zo kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, Judah mite in, “Ei muh zawh loh dingin amah koilam pai ding hiam? A kitheh zak a, om Grik mite lakah pai ding a, Grik mite kiangah thu a hilh ding hiam?
‘Nong zon’ uh hangin nong mu kei ding uh hi,’ leh, ‘Ka omna mun na tung zo kei ding uh hi,’ a cihna in bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?” ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Pawikham a tawp ni alianpen ni-in Zeisu ding a, “Mi khatpeuh in tui a duh leh, ka kiangah hong pai-in dawn ta hen.
Kei hong umte Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh bangin, ama sung pan nuntakna guntui a luangkhia ding hi,” ci-in a kiko hi.
Tua bang a cihna in a umte’ ngah ding Kha Siangtho a cihna ahi hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Zeisu in minthan’na ngah nai lo ahih ciangin Kha Siangtho a kipia nai kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mihonpi kimkhat in tua thu a zak uh ciangin, “Hih pa in aman takpi-in kamsangpa ahi hi,” a ci uh hi.
Kimkhat in, “Hih pa in Khazih hi,” a ci uh hi. Kimkhat in, “Khazih in Galile gam pan hong suak thei ding hiam?
Khazih in David’ suan hi a, David’ omna Bethlehem khua sungah a suak ding hi,” ci-in Lai Siangtho in ci hilo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, mihonpite lakah amah hangin thu kituak loin a kikhenthang uh hi.
Tua bangin mi kimkhatte in Topa a mat nop uh hangin kuamah in ama tungah khut a nga kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin palikte, siampi liante leh Farisaite kiangah a ciahkik uh ciangin tuate in, “Bang hangin hong paipih lo na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Palikte in, “Tua pa’ hilh bangin kuamah in a hilh ngei kei hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, Farisaite in, “No nangawn hong kheem zo ahi hiam?
Upa vaihawmte lakah ahi zongin, Farisaite lakah ahi zongin amah a um mi khat beek a om hiam?
Thukhamna a thei lo hih mihonpite in kosiatna ngahte ahi uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
A nidanga Zeisu kiangah hong pai, amaute laka khat Nikodemas in,
“Eite Thukhamna in mi thu za a, a gamtatna thu a theih ma-in a thu khen thei hiam?” a ci hi.
Amaute in, “Nang zong Galile mi na hi hiam? Galile gam sung pan kamsangpa a piang ngei hiam ci-in na zon’ leh piang ngei lo ci-in na thei ding hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, mi khempeuh amau innah a ciah uh hi.
